instruction.name: x86mttop
instruction.description: Set the x87 TOP pointer to imm.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'x86mttop 0' --asm 'x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.47 cycles. Measured CPI 1.0588; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 1. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: The TOP pointer is renamed; a mttop/mftop loop runs at about 1.2 cycles per pair, so no latency chain through TOP is observable. Only throughput is recorded.
